Help Palawa Joko reinforce his return to power and destroy the undead groups that have thrown off his rule.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Stop the rampaging [[undead]] in [[Joko's Domain]]. 6...0 groups of undead remain.
* See Palawa Joko for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,500 [[Experience]]
* 200 [[Gold]]
* [[Ancient Artifact]]

==Walkthrough==
Follow the quest pointer to each of the six groups in turn.  All 6 are found on rocky ground to the south east of the Bone Palace, which [[Junundu|wurms]] cannot tunnel through.  The party will however have to use wurms to leave the Bone Palace and reach the initial rocky area.

Bringing [[disruption]] skills or even better [[Frozen Soil]] can severely speed up this quest because of the number of [[resurrection]] skills the undead groups have.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Palawa Joko'''
:''"The fleshlings return, and not a moment too soon! My armies have disintegrated in my absence, and my former '''slaves''' have gone utterly insane. While I was sealed away all those years, those worthless shells shed their restraints and began to attack anything that moved! They are a menace to everyone. Do be a peach and take care of them for me. I'll make it worth your while."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I'll smite your rebellious undead.
|decline = The joke's on you, Joko. You can't keep an undead brother down.
|ask = The wild undead still walk. What are you waiting for? }}

===Reward dialogue===
'''Palawa Joko'''
:''"Excellent. I shall make sure that the vanquished stay that way. The fact that those slaves broke their bonds is an outrage, but they won't be bothering anyone again."''



==Trivia==
* ''[[W:The Return of the King|The Return of the King]]'' is the title of the third book in ''The Lord of the Rings'' trilogy by [[w:J. R. R. Tolkien|J. R. R. Tolkien]].
